title: Saint Sarkis Cathedral, Tehran

architecture.roofPhase: later opaque conical covering with drum lights

sources.facts: The University of Tehran survey documents a long rectangular church with a polygonal east apse, orthogonal projecting wings, the west triangular front, narrow vertical openings, recessed triangular niches, a dominant dome, and distinct western bell entrances. It records the filled-in original glass façade and the opaque replacement of glazing on the pyramidal dome roof.
Iran’s tourism authority documents white marble on the exterior, one larger western gate flanked by smaller openings, two secondary entrances under the bell towers, a conical dome and east altar.
The Armenian embassy identifies the present cathedral as the seat of the Tehran Diocese and records the 50th anniversary of its consecration in 2023.

notes: Searched published Qualla originals first. The unknown-photographer street view lacks primary publication evidence and the interior painting does not show the exterior. The model uses the measured footprint and first-hand written architectural sources.
